_rule: Written and committed BEFORE the run (AGENTS.md). Native hair qualification at Ultra (smoke_ultra keys + the hair startup latches). Energy = float mean of the scene colour before post (pass 5c3fdabc): character ROI (skin + hair class of the trace's RT2.a) by char_energy.py (branch worktree-agent-a0c9be1ab336eae1a, needs dump_preview_f32=1: merge it first) and the whole frame from dumps.json. Spread = relative std of shot-off-a/b/c in that ROI. Cost = rt passes GPU cost (300-frame line) of cost-hair minus mean(cost-off-a, cost-off-b), with |off-a - off-b| as its noise.

_hair_gi_cull.key: rt_hair_gi_cull=0/1, default 0; native hair/scalp/origin remain on in every added window
_hair_gi_cull.scope: Exclude native procedural hair from GI closest rays only; preserve primary, sun/local shadows, GI-hit shadow visibility, AO and reflection rays.
_hair_gi_cull.predicted: GI GPU cost decreases, bounded by the observed +3.2 ms native-hair GI excess in S8. RT passes GPU cost should stay within the cull-off repeat spread. No claim that the original < 1.0 ms native-hair cost gate will pass.
_hair_gi_cull.comparison: Within one run: cost-hair-cull-off-a / cost-hair-cull-on / cost-hair-cull-off-b. Subtract mean OFF from ON independently for gi and rt passes GPU ms; report |OFF-a - OFF-b| as repeat noise. Each cost window must contain complete 300-frame lines for both metrics, with diagnostics off and no builds.
_hair_gi_cull.quality: shot-cull-off-a / shot-cull-on / shot-cull-off-b with held exposure; compare float pre-post scene and character ROI energy against OFF repeat spread. Inspect hair sun/local shadows on skin; GI lighting differences must be reported, not dismissed as equivalent.
_hair_gi_cull.qualification: Positive GI savings above OFF repeat spread; skin/hair shadows preserved; total native-hair cost < 1.0 ms over the existing no-hair baseline still required. Keep key and native hair off in presets pending live evidence.
